wu: Travel Bingo: Students get bingo cards with travel pictures (plane, hotel, beach, etc.). Teacher calls out words, students mark them and shout 'Bingo!' when they have a line. They say 'I went to [place]' for each marked item.
wuAlt: Travel Pictionary: One student draws a travel word, others guess. They say 'Is it a hotel?'
Travel Charades: Students act out travel actions (flying, swimming), others guess 'Are you swimming?'
pres: Show a picture of Eid al-Fitr celebration and a holiday abroad (e.g., beach holiday). Point and say 'On Eid, we visit family. On holiday, we swim.' Elicit sentences from students using 'I went to...' and 'I saw...'. Check with thumbs up/down if they understand 'past simple for finished actions'.
presAlt: Use a simple story: 'Last Eid, I visited grandma. Last summer, I went to Agadir.' Ask 'When did you go?'
Bring realia: a prayer mat (Eid) and sunglasses (holiday). Students handle them and make sentences.
prac: Travel Buddy Interview: Students work in pairs. Interview each other with 'Where did you go last holiday?' and 'What did you see?'. Write answers in a table. Support with sentence starters on the board.
pracAlt: Holiday Brochure Match: Match picture cards (beach, mountain) to word cards. Say 'This is a beach holiday.'
Past Simple Drill: Teacher says 'go', students say 'went'. Repeat with 'see/saw', 'visit/visited'.
ls: Listen to a dialogue between two friends talking about their Eid and holiday trips. Students fill in a simple grid with 'Name', 'Place', 'Activity'. Check answers with 'Who went to the mountains?'
re: Simon Says Travel: Teacher says 'Simon says swim like you're at the beach!' or 'Simon says pray like it's Eid!'. Students move and repeat the actions. Fast-paced to re-energize.
prod: Holiday Brochure Corner: Groups design a simple travel brochure for 'Eid in Morocco' or 'A Holiday Abroad'. Include 3 pictures and 3 sentences using 'I went to...' and 'I saw...'. Present to the class.
rw: Read a short text about a boy's Eid and a girl's holiday trip. Complete a Venn diagram with similarities and differences. Then write 4 sentences comparing them using 'Both... and...', 'But...'.
st: Read a simple story about a child's Eid holiday. Sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It' with travel actions (clap if you went swimming, stomp if you visited family). End with 'Today we learned to talk about past holidays. Thank you, class!'
g: Students flip over picture cards (travel words), find pairs, and say a sentence with each word.
Teams race to write past tense forms on the board (go->went, see->saw).
One student describes a holiday, others guess 'Was it Eid or a beach holiday?'
Students mark off travel words called by the teacher, shout 'Bingo!' when done.
Students use word cards to make past simple sentences about holidays.
diff: Fast finishers: Write 3 more sentences about their own Eid or holiday.
Support: Use sentence frames 'I went to ______. I saw ______.' to write.
hw: Write 8 sentences comparing Eid al-Fitr with another holiday (e.g., Christmas, summer holiday). Use 'Both... and...' and 'But...'.
Draw a picture of your favorite holiday and write 3 sentences about it using past simple.
Interview a family member about their past holiday and write 2 sentences they said.
tip: Use the local context of Eid al-Fitr to make past simple practice relevant. Compare it with holidays abroad to build cultural awareness and keep teens engaged with familiar themes.
